async def act(page):
    # Click on the Catalog menu to open it
    await page.get_by_role("link", name=" Catalog", exact=True).click()
    # Wait for the submenu to appear; assume it loads quickly
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # brief pause for UI update
    # Now click on the Products link in the submenu; based on typical Magento, the name might be "Products"
    # Since it's not in the current tree, I'll use a generic selector, but to be safe, I'll look for a link with name containing "Products"
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Products").click()
    # Wait for the Products page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On the Products page, click the "Add Product" button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add Product").click()
    # Wait for the product creation modal/page
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Select "Simple Product" type; might be a dropdown or button
    # In Magento, it's often a dropdown; I'll use get_by_role for combobox or select
    # But let's assume it's a button or link; I'll use get_by_role with name "Simple Product"
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Simple Product").click()
    # Wait for the form to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Fill in product name
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Product Name").fill("FancyBoy Man Causal Jeans")
    # Fill in price; might be in a specific field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Price").fill("169.99")
    # Set stock quantity; might be in an inventory section
    # I'll navigate to the Inventory tab or field
    await page.get_by_role("tab", name="Inventory").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Qty").fill("42")
    # Set size and color attributes; these might be in an Attributes section or dropdowns
    # I'll go to the Attributes tab or similar
    await page.get_by_role("tab", name="Attributes").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    # For size: select option "34" from a dropdown
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Size").select_option("34")
    # For color: select option "Blue" from a dropdown
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Color").select_option("Blue")
    # Save the product
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    # Wait for save to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
